Payout of 5 August is short ₹2,687.56.
The bank credited ₹3,83,418.40 against an expected ₹3,86,105.96. 25 orders sit in this payout. No refund, chargeback or payment in the gateway ledger accounts for the difference, so the cause is not yet identified.
Suggested action: request the gateway's own breakdown for this payout, and check for a dispute debited but not yet reported.
